en.topic_title: China announces ‘countermeasures’ after US trade sanctions

zh.topic_title: China announces ‘countermeasures’ after US trade sanctions

en.topic_title: China announces ‘countermeasures’ after US trade sanctions
en.topic_summary:
China announced restrictions on drone exports to the United States and blacklisted six companies on Wednesday in response to trade sanctions imposed by Washington over forced labour and national security concerns.



DJI drone. Photo: DJI.



The move comes days after the United States imposed fresh tariffs on China and 59 other countries, adding to a series of recent trade measures.



The US actions “seriously harm China’s legitimate rights and interests”, a commerce ministry
